visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, styled hair wearing a black ribbed blazer and a black t-shirt stands in a dimly lit studio environment with shelves and blurry background items. He speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands to emphasize his points. Yellow and white subtitles appear at the bottom center of the frame. (2) The scene shifts to a black-and-white historical portrait of an older man in a high-collared military uniform with medals. Then, a top-down view of a historical military map with small red and blue markers is shown, depicting a tactical wargame setup on a beige parchment-like surface. (3) A colorful historical painting of a grand assembly in a hall with many people in 19th-century attire is displayed. This is followed by rapid-fire anime-style cinematic footage featuring a male warrior with black hair and a female warrior with dark hair, both wielding glowing swords in a dark, atmospheric setting with sparks and energy effects. (4) The visuals transition to actual mobile game footage showing a desert-like grid map with small 3D anime characters moving and attacking in a turn-based strategy style. Combat animations show flashy purple and white energy effects, sword slashes, and characters performing special moves. (5) Various character portraits and splash arts are shown, including a group of anime heroes in diverse fantasy armor and robes. The man returns to the screen, speaking with high energy while large text overlays showing a promotion code 'SHASHA77' and a download call-to-action appear prominently over him.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with medium-length dark hair, wearing a black textured/ribbed vertical-stripe blazer over a plain black t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A professional studio with soft backlighting and blurred equipment on shelves, transitioning to historical artwork, and then high-quality 3D anime game environments including deserts and dark fantasy halls.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male speaker delivering high-energy Mandarin narration with clear articulation and an engaging, professional tone. A subtle, rhythmic electronic beat pulses in the background. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' and a cinematic 'thud' SFX mark the transition to the historical section. The BGM swells with orchestral strings, adding a sense of historical gravitas. (3) As the game footage appears, the music shifts to a high-tempo, epic anime-style track with prominent percussion and soaring synths. Sharp 'slash' SFX and energy-explosion sounds are layered over the narration to match the on-screen combat. (4) Digital UI 'blip' and 'click' sounds occur frequently during gameplay segments, mimicking menu interaction. (5) The speaker's volume increases and pitch rises slightly during the final call-to-action, accompanied by a final musical crescendo and a resonant 'ping' SFX as the promotion code is highlighted.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the mobile game 'The War of Genesis M: The Asura Project' by linking its strategic gameplay to the historical origins of wargaming. It uses an energetic host and cinematic game footage to appeal to players who enjoy tactical SRPGs.
